name: useradd
summary: Create a new user or update default new user information.
description: Low-level utility for adding a new user account on Linux systems.

options.description: Specify login shell for new user.

examples.title: Create user with home directory and bash shell
examples.explanation: Creates user ctfuser with home directory and /bin/bash shell.

useCases: Provisioning new user accounts on servers
warnings: useradd typically requires root; new accounts immediately gain login and file-access rights on the system.
